title: How Norway Built the Biggest Wealth Fund on Earth
status: DRAFT VIDEO. Script draft v3 (approved 24 November 2026), whole video. Scenes on the `placeholder` template stand in for footage, photos and graphics not made yet.
notes: Storyboard for script draft 3 (brief.md), following storyboard-plan.md. Words match the approved script; only caption splits and cues are added.
IPPR is written 'I P P R' in the spoken text so it's read as letters.
Placeholders: every footage or photo slot, and every graphic not built yet (grid, document, map dots, the three custom scenes, the oil-price chart), is a dark card saying what goes there.

Changes from the plan: the hook's coast footage became a North Sea map (the line is about oil, and the fjord footage is kept for the takeaway); the fund's growth chart (row 24) became a two-bar 'paid in against earned' split, which needs no extra data; the company name wall (row 26) became an icon row (phone, car, Norway), so no company is named without NBIM's holdings list; the budget share is a number card until `grid` exists; the US Capitol shot before the end card is left out (outro A sits on the `end` template).
Dry-well positions on the map are illustrative and labelled so. The dividing line follows the 1965 agreement's eight points as recalled (point 8 checked); a schematic, not a chart.
Draft 1's sample scenes, its Short and its thumbnail cut are in git history (before 24 November 2026). Thumbnails need redoing for draft 3.
